title: About the Author
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Neal Town Stephenson is the author of Snow Crash , The Diamond Age , Zodiac , and The Big U . Born on Halloween 1959 in Fort Meade, Maryland — home of the National Security Agency — he grew up in Champaign-Urbana, Illinois, and Ames, Iowa, before attending college in Boston. Since 1984 he has lived mostly in the Pacific Northwest and has made a living out of writing novels and the occasional magazine article.
